title: 第11章 路遇野鸳鸯干他一票第12章 这重操旧业才是修仙的正确姿势
content_zh:
他话音未落，几个被“丹童”美差冲昏了头的杂役便红着眼扑了上来。
纯小白不退反进，转身一记干脆利落的鞭腿，直接将包上来的三四个人扫翻在地，滚作一团。
他这山大王可是祖传的，怎么可能没两下子？
他从三岁就开始练就凡人间武功。
再加上一拳能打出三千斤的天生神力，别说这几个手无缚鸡之力的杂役弟子，就是当年官府派来的千军万马，也没能将他赶出黑风寨。
“咔咔咔！”
纯小白左手顺势一转，王帆的胳膊直接被他拧成了一条麻花。
“啊！！”王帆脸色涨成了猪肝，额头冷汗直冒。
下一秒。
纯小白目光又落在了王帆那只金鸡独立的膝盖上，毫不留情地一脚踹了过去。
“咔嚓！”
王帆那凄厉的惨叫声戛然而止，白眼一翻，直接痛晕了过去，像一滩烂泥般瘫倒在地。
那些杂役弟子见状，吓的一步步往后退。
这家伙就是个疯子！
才来第一天，竟然连杂役管事都敢废？
“来来来！”纯小白朝着他们招了招手，“你们可以一起上，将本大王抓上去邀功！”
他声音一落。
咣当一声，那些杂役弟子全都缩进茅草屋，生怕这个疯子一言不合，连他们也给废了。
“就这？”
纯小白不屑地拍了拍手，往地上啐了一口唾沫。

“你们不当杂役弟子，谁当杂役弟子？”
他撇了撇嘴，便露出一股山大王的气势，背着手大摇大摆地就朝山下走去。
“你妹的，老子还是找个山头插一支旗，重操旧业去当我的山大王去！不受这个鸟气了！”
……
想象很美好，现实不仅骨感，还给了他两个大嘴巴子。
纯小白万万没想到，这修仙世界比他在凡间当土匪还要卷。
自己堂堂黑风寨八百里扛把子，如今竟然要沦落到给人刷马桶？
这要是被山下那帮兄弟们知道，怕是要活活笑死。
清风拂过，不仅没让他感觉到一丝清爽，反而像是在煽风点火，让他心里的火气“蹭蹭”往上冒。
纯小白闷着头走着走着，脚步突然一顿。
他发现……自己迷路了。
前方是一座陡峭的高山，左边是一片密不透风的荆棘丛林，扎进去怕是要被刮下一层皮来。
右边则是一条湍急的小河，水流撞在石头上哗哗作响。
“嘶！”纯小白抓着后脑勺，一脸懵圈。
“昨天到底是打哪儿上来的？”
他前后左右转着圈瞅了半天，发现几条看似是路的小径都在这里戛然而止。
他知道这里是仙人的地盘，炼气中期弟子都可以借助飞剑短暂御空飞行，平时压根就不用赶路。
毕竟路都是人走出来的。
“那岂不是没人指路，本大王想下山只能自己趟出一条路来？”
纯小白琢磨了一下，又摇头嘀咕道：“不行！”

“必须得整点盘缠和干粮，不然很可能会饿死在这半道上。”
这个修仙世界，地大物博，在天上看着只是一瞬便路过一座城池，真正走起来估计至少也有几千里。
content_en:
Before he finished speaking, several handymen who were dazzled by "Dantong"'s good job pounced on him with red eyes.
Chun Xiaobai didn't retreat but advanced. He turned around and whipped the three or four people he was surrounded by with a sharp whip, sweeping them to the ground and rolling them into a ball.
He, the mountain king, was passed down from his ancestors, so how could he not have done it twice?
He has been practicing martial arts in the mortal world since he was three years old.
Coupled with the natural power of being able to punch three thousand kilograms with one punch, not to mention these helpless disciples, even the thousands of troops sent by the government could not drive him out of Black Wind Village.
"Kakaka!"
Chun Xiaobai turned his left hand and Wang Fan's arm was twisted into a twist.
"Ah!!" Wang Fan's face turned red and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
The next second.
Chun Xiaobai's eyes fell on the independent knee of Wang Fan's golden rooster again, and he kicked it mercilessly.
"Crack!"
Wang Fan's shrill screams suddenly stopped, he rolled his eyes, fainted from the pain, and collapsed to the ground like a puddle of mud.
When the handyman disciples saw this, they stepped back step by step in fear.
This guy is a lunatic!
It's just your first day here, and you dare to dismiss even the handyman and manager?
"Come on, come on!" Chun Xiaobai waved to them, "You can come together and capture this king to claim credit!"
His voice dropped.
With a bang, the handyman disciples all retreated into the thatched hut, fearing that this lunatic's disagreement would destroy them too.
"That's it?"
Chun Xiaobai clapped his hands disdainfully and spat on the ground.
"If you don't want to be a handyman disciple, who should be a handyman disciple?"
He curled his lips, showing off the aura of a mountain king, and swaggered down the mountain with his hands behind his back.
"Damn it, I'd better find a mountain to plant a flag on, go back to my old career and become my mountain king! I won't tolerate this nonsense anymore!"
…
The imagination was beautiful, but the reality was not only skinny, but also gave him two big mouths.
Chun Xiaobai never expected that this world of cultivating immortals would be more complicated than when he was a bandit in the mortal world.
He has been in charge of Heifeng Village for 800 miles, but now he is reduced to cleaning toilets for others?
If the brothers at the foot of the mountain knew about this, they would probably laugh to death.
The breeze blew by, not only did it not make him feel refreshed, but it seemed to fan the flames, causing the anger in his heart to rise.
Chun Xiaobai was walking with his head downcast, when his footsteps suddenly stopped.
He found...that he was lost.
Ahead is a steep mountain, and to the left is an airtight thorny jungle. If you plunge into it, you may be scraped off a layer of skin.
On the right is a fast river, with water rushing against the rocks.
"Hiss!" Chun Xiaobai scratched the back of his head, looking confused.
"Where did you come from yesterday?"
He looked around in circles for a long time, and found that several paths that looked like roads ended abruptly here.
He knew that this was the territory of immortals. In the middle stage of Qi refining, disciples could fly in the air for a short time with the help of flying swords, and there was no need to rush at all.
After all, the roads are made by people.
"Doesn't it mean that there is no one to show the way? If I want to go down the mountain, I have to find my own way?"
Chun Xiaobai thought about it for a moment, then shook his head and muttered: "No!"
"You must have enough food and clothing, otherwise you will probably starve to death halfway along the road."
This world of cultivating immortals is vast and rich in resources. From the sky, you can pass by a city in just a blink of an eye. In real life, it is estimated to be at least several thousand miles away.
